cards.ex: Add a dash of hot sauce for extra flavor.
cards.exUz: Qo'shimcha ta'm uchun bir oz achchiq sous qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Oz miqdordagi suyuqlik yoki ziravor.

cards.ex: The chef created a culinary masterpiece that left us speechless.
cards.exUz: Oshpaz shunday oshpazlik durdonasini yaratdiki, biz gapirishga ham so'z topa olmadik.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi va murakkab tayyorlangan taom, san'at asari kabi.

cards.ex: I need a saucepan to heat up the soup.
cards.exUz: Menga sho'rvani isitish uchun kastrulka kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qopqoqli, kichikroq idish, suyuqliklar tayyorlash uchun.

cards.ex: That new restaurant is a real foodie haven; you should check it out.
cards.exUz: O'sha yangi restoran haqiqiy ishtahaochar maskan; borib ko'rsangiz bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Mazali taomlar yeyishni yoqtiradiganlar uchun jannatdek joy.

cards.ex: The aroma of the stew made us simmer with anticipation.
cards.exUz: Dimlangan go'shtning hidi bizni intiqib kutishga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqat pishishini sabrsizlik bilan kutish.

cards.ex: New York City is a melting pot of cultures and cuisines.
cards.exUz: Nyu-York shahri madaniyatlar va oshxonalarning millatlar aralashmasidir.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil madaniyat va millatlarning birlashgan joyi.

cards.ex: Take his stories with a pinch of salt; he tends to exaggerate.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyalarini bir chimdim tuz bilan qabul qiling; u mubolag'a qilishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Bir oz shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: He simmered with rage when he saw what they had done to his kitchen.
cards.exUz: U oshxonasiga nima qilganlarini ko'rganda qahr bilan qaynadim.
cards.uzDef: Ichida qattiq g'azabni his qilish, lekin tashqariga chiqarmaslik.

cards.ex: I baked a batch of cookies for the party.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofat uchun bir partiya pechene pishirdim.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtning o'zida tayyorlangan pechenelar to'plami.

cards.ex: For me, cooking is food for the soul; it brings me so much joy.
cards.exUz: Men uchun ovqat pishirish ruh uchun ozuqa; u menga juda ko'p quvonch baxsh etadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'ngilni ko'taradigan va qondiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: My grandmother always makes creamed corn for Thanksgiving; it's a family tradition.
cards.exUz: Buвим хар доим Шукур куни учун қаймоқли маккажухори тайёрлайди; бу оилавий анъана.
cards.uzDef: Qaymoq va sariyog' bilan tayyorlangan makkajo'xori taomi.

cards.ex: Let the flavors meld together for at least an hour before serving the stew.
cards.exUz: Бульонни тортишдан олдин камида бир соат давомида таъмлар аралашиб кетсин.
cards.uzDef: Ingredientlarning bir-biriga aralashib, bitta ta'mga aylanishi.

cards.ex: Her culinary prowess is evident in every dish she creates.
cards.exUz: Uning хар бир таомида ошпазлик махорати кўриниб туради.
cards.uzDef: Oshxonada yuqori darajadagi mahorat va iste'dod.

cards.ex: Add salt and pepper to taste.
cards.exUz: Таъмга кўра туз ва мурч қўшинг.
cards.uzDef: Ta'bga mos ravishda ingredient qo'shish.

cards.ex: Cut the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
cards.exUz: Аралашма қўпол ушоққа ўхшагунча, сариёғни унга кесиб аралаштиринг.
cards.uzDef: Sovuq sariyog'ni un bilan pichoq yordamida aralashtirish.

cards.ex: I prefer bone-in chicken because it's more flavorful.
cards.exUz: Мен суякли товуқни афзал кўраман, чунки у мазалироқ.
cards.uzDef: Suyagi bo'lgan go'sht bo'lagi.

cards.ex: Let the chicken marinate overnight for the best flavor.
cards.exUz: Энг яхши таъм учун товуқни тунда marinadlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Go'shtni marinadga solib, ta'mini yaxshilash.

cards.ex: Good mise en place is key to a smooth cooking process.
cards.exUz: Яхши mise en place - мукаммал пишириш жараёнининг асоси.
cards.uzDef: Pazandachilikda barcha ingredientlarni oldindan tayyorlash.

cards.ex: Deglaze the pan with wine to create a rich sauce.
cards.exUz: Бой соус яратиш учун товоқни вино билан тозаланг.
cards.uzDef: Pishirishdan so'ng tovani suyuqlik bilan tozalash.

cards.ex: Reducing food miles is important for environmental sustainability.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat masofasini qisqartirish atrof-muhit barqarorligi uchun muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqatning yetkazib berilishi uchun bosib o'tgan masofasi.

cards.ex: We support the farm-to-table movement by buying local produce.
cards.exUz: Biz mahalliy mahsulotlarni sotib olish orqali fermadan stolga harakatini qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Mahalliy fermalardan olingan ingredientlardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: Olives are an acquired taste for many people.
cards.exUz: Zaytun ko'pchilik uchun o'rganib qoladigan ta'm.
cards.uzDef: Dastlab yoqimsiz bo'lgan, keyin esa yoqadigan ta'm.

cards.ex: Don't dress the salad until just before serving.
cards.exUz: Salatni tortishdan oldin sous qo'ymang.
cards.uzDef: Salatga sous quyish.

cards.ex: Make sure to proof the yeast before adding it to the flour.
cards.exUz: Unni qo'shishdan oldin achitqini tekshirishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Xamir uchun achitqini yaroqliligini tekshirish.

cards.ex: This chocolate cake is incredibly rich and decadent.
cards.exUz: Bu shokoladli tort juda бой ва мазали.
cards.uzDef: O'ta mazali va to'yimli taom.

cards.ex: Cooking new recipes is always a culinary adventure for me.
cards.exUz: Yangi retseptlarni tayyorlash men uchun har doim oshpazlik sarguzashti.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va qiziqarli taomlar tayyorlash tajribasi.

cards.ex: A squeeze of lemon juice can really bring out the flavor of the fish.
cards.exUz: Bir siqim limon suvi baliqning ta'mini ochib berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ingredientning asl ta'mini kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: The chef cooked the steak to perfection.
cards.exUz: Oshpaz biftekni mukammal pishirdi.
cards.uzDef: Taomni eng yaxshi holatga pishirish.

cards.ex: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
cards.exUz: Guruch ko'plab Osiyo mamlakatlarida asosiy oziq-ovqatdir.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik iste'mol qilinadigan asosiy oziq-ovqat mahsuloti.

cards.ex: The key to a good dish is a perfect balance of flavors.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi taomning asosi - ta'mlarning mukammal muvozanati.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil ta'mlarning yaxshi muvozanati.
